# cato_socket_site_ha (Resource)

Configures Cloud Router mode on an existing Cato socket site. Use this resource after the secondary vSocket has been registered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cato_socket_site_ha" "cloud_router" {
  # The site must already have its secondary GCP vSocket registered.
  site_id        = "12345"
  is_cloud_router = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `is_cloud_router` (Boolean) Enable or disable Cloud Router mode for the HA socket site.
- `site_id` (String) Cato socket site ID. The secondary vSocket must already be registered.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Site ID used as the resource ID.
